title: With BETA_GATE=on and the whitelist on another origin, a same-origin non-JSON write bound for dsh still reaches the workspace proxy instead of a 415 from the CSRF guard
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run the command in `run.cmd`.
S2: Read the result of each test named in `run.tests`.
expect: Every test named in run.tests reports ok.

selectors.function: apps/tracy-web/src/app.js buildApp (use, owners, formAction middleware); apps/tracy-web/src/lib/csrf.js ownerOf

fence: Every middleware in front of the CSRF guard is declared through use(), so ownerOf skips it and finds the dsh catch-all; memory store, no network.

tests: with the beta gate on, a dsh upload still reaches the proxy with its own body type
dsh reads its own bodies: a same-origin binary write the router hands to the proxy keeps its type
